column2:
The world was overflowing with Chaos.
War, plague, famine, disaster...
There were children who fell to their knees, helpless,
only afraid, only trembling, in tears.
There were adults who cursed their own folly, unable
to save even their own children.

No hand was held out to them.
No sheltering canopy was there.

The world was overflowing with Chaos.
Tears of sorrow fell from clear eyes.
Is that why it took root?
The school that came to be called Elmenas was
beginning to draw breath there.

The too-long age of Chaos seemed as if it would never
end.
People and dragons, beasts and giants, birds of prey
and plants, the green folk and the hammer folk...
All were worn out, driven by fear and dread, and still.
No.
Because of that, they never forgot to fear and hate
each other.
Because of that, the flesh and blood offered to the
too-long age of Chaos never ceased.

Through that long, long night...
no one paid any heed.
Buried in a blackness even beasts turned their eyes
from, those who faced the hardship were very small.
Yet on their faces, beneath sorrow and rage and grief,
swirled a compassion that lived side by side with
madness...
There they were, silently burning their lives away only
to drive off Chaos.
Had you looked their way, their deep-cut wrinkles
would have, today as always, broken easily into a rich
smile.
In time, they came to be called sages.

They wished.
For a smile on everyone, each and every one.
That alone was the wish of the sages.
It was a small step toward a land of harmony.

It was long, long ago that the school of the East came
to be honoured by the name Elmenas.
In the age of creation...
the circle of people was a very small one.
Over the long flow of time it met war, famine, plague
and disaster, and with each one it faced, it slowly took
shape.

And so its long history and the sincere hearts of its
sages won people's respect.
All who study at Elmenas walk with pride in that.
"Never to stain the trust that has been built."
It is no exaggeration to say that this feeling upholds
the sages' strict resolve.

The name for those who stand against the war,
famine, disaster and plague that fill the world.
They are sorcerers, priests, hunters, and warriors too.
They gather from every corner of the world at the
school of sages, hone their strength and skill, and
leave the nest.
Above all, the school teaches a heart that will not be
overcome by that great power.
"At that moment, why, and what must I do?"
That, you could say, is everything the school nurtures.

Grotesque monsters that have appeared only at
Elmenas, the school of sages.
Utterly alien to the "living" of the wide world: that is
what the Crawlers are.
They were born of twisted Chaos.
Fearfully, they were cloaked in a negative power that
is anathema to sages.
Sages hold themselves up by strength, skill and heart.
As a strong light makes a deeper darkness, the
Crawlers stand before the sages with negative
strength, negative skill and a negative heart.
Because sages are so unshakable, before the Crawlers
they become a dangerous double-edged sword.
That power at the same time steals sanity from the
heart.
The longer a sage faces them, the sooner the sage's
heart loses its reason, and the sage meets a
self-destroying end.
A grotesque Chaos come from the dark.
Beyond that, nothing certain is known of their
purpose or reason.
Only one thing is a sure fact: they brought down the
Central Schoolhouse of Elmenas and took it.
In that battle, many sages fell into darkness, and the
children were scattered.

The Crawlers who prowl the school: foes the sages
cannot touch.
Yet because they were young and unfinished, because
their hearts were frail but clear, the children could
fight the Crawlers.
The children realised that the closer one comes to a
sage's heights, the shorter one can stand against
them.
"I want to help my teacher."
Of course, if sages give everything they have, even for
a short time, they may at times defeat Chaos.
But the sages would not come away unharmed, and
beyond doubt the scars of destruction would wound
Elmenas deeply.
The law that sages must avoid battle with the
Crawlers.
The torment of having to entrust a hard fight and a
heavy burden to children.
That some sages took up the fight at the Central
Schoolhouse, knowing it was hopeless, shows that
anguish well.
And as a result, not a few fell or went missing, and the
Central Schoolhouse was left in rubble.

The school is a place not everyone can enter, and at
the same time a place where everyone has a chance
to enter.
It does not ask for much.
To carry a clear heart.
To walk with all your might, however faint and frail.
The children who study at Elmenas all have such a
heart.
And that is why they can challenge the "grotesque
Chaos" that ordinary people, and even sages, cannot
face.

Denehere Ruverdracloa (105, male)
One of the Four Sage Envoys of Elmenas, the Head of
Wings.
A great old sage who laid the foundations of the
Shield of Purity as its founder and led it to golden age
after golden age.
Though old and retired from the front line, his deep
eyes, undimmed still, hold the wisdom that finds
great people.

Palmra Ruverdracloa (18, female)
Graceful and elegant in manner, the most gifted
woman in all Elmenas.
As the Shield of Purity's mother figure, she pours
overflowing love on its young children.
But she will never let anything that goes against
morals pass.
Strict because she is kind, and all the kinder because
she is strict.
A silver rose holding a fierce flame within...
That is her true self.

Sesiris Finott (14, female)
A sweet girl raised with a heart that does not feel even
the harshest adversity as such.
She takes the path shown to her straight to heart and
works at it with complete sincerity, never lacking care
despite her youth.
Yet Sesiris thinks it lazy and shameful even to share
her worries or ask for advice.
When that over-earnest heart suddenly wavers, the
feelings piled up inside her come to light.
Will she end as just a good student who understands
everything?
Or will she take a new step of her own will?
Carrying the Shield of Purity's hopes alone, her story
is about to meet its first trial.

Illion Vinnat (13, male)
A shy, quiet boy who tends to keep his eyes down.
In the past, hidden behind the great senior Rossaria
Ordinar, the Judge, his name never came to the fore.
Yet it is plain fact that, as one wing of the priests, he
has steadily supported the Shield of Purity.
Illion simply keeps on working, single-mindedly.
There were times when some thoughtlessly teased
him for showing no visible results.
With tears welling faintly, Illion still prays in silence
and turns to his desk.

Orphes Romanova (25)
The brightest talent in Innocentia, with beautiful
platinum hair, and a sorcerer.
Studying under the master Denehere, Orphes was
named a guide of the Four at an unheard-of young
age.

Faldra Belis (89, male)
Denehere's junior and partner in mischief.
An old sage of still-unbowed build, with a striking,
vigorous gaze.
Even Denehere admits his skill, but perhaps for his
free and bold nature, he settles for a minor post in
Elmenas.

Oskir Vainheart (17, male)
A tough swordsman who carried an era of Innocentia,
the Shield of Purity, a great house of the Four now in
steady decline.
He is set on becoming a sage, and above all, he loves
the Shield of Purity and the school deeply.
With not a cloud in his sincere eyes, Oskir holds
himself strictly as a model for his young juniors.
Keeping the memory of his cruelly ruined homeland
in his heart, he walks the path he believes in.

Rossaria Ordinar (17, female)
A prodigy called, in awe, the Angel of Death's Tidings.
As a prophet of the underworld skilled in dark curses,
great things are expected of her.
Yet the foreseeing eyes that bloomed when she was
young made her shunned as a cursed child who finds
misfortune and ill omens.
At the end of a long, long night, a sage of Elmenas
lifted her out of the dark, and she became a pupil and
walked a new road.
Ignoring what everyone looks at, Rossaria spins
words no one else can pierce.
Tormented by the guilt her uncanny eyes bring, yet
trusting only the passion welling up from the depths
of her heart, she walks on.

Sirius Musie (12, male)
Born to a shining life in a famous great noble house,
Sirius chose the hard road on purpose.
Blessed with fine talent for sorcery, he refused to join
Paladine, the Hall of Wisdom, hating to be put in a
mould.
Will he live on a set path, or cut his own?
Allowing no slackness in himself or anyone, now
sharp-tongued, now throwing out challenges:
perhaps it is to spur himself on.
Joining Gospel Brass, the warriors' refuge that lives
by righteousness, and feeling a pleasant unease, what
will he find...

Alsea Bellthird (16, female)
Alsea, a taciturn swordswoman who holds to her first
resolve with firm conviction.
She was chosen for the glorious duty of young
guardian to Sirius, heir of the Grand Ducal House of
Musie.
Later, sent to Elmenas far from her war-torn
homeland, she kept her distance from her lord and
joined St. Sevies.
But as she took the Bellthird name and began to walk
the way of the Sword Saint, a harsh choice awaited
her.
...The retreat from the shining Central Schoolhouse,
the heart of Elmenas.
Whom to save from the Crawlers: her friends, or her
lord?
Spurred on by her comrades' silent urging, Alsea
rushed to her lord.
She protected Sirius to the end, but in losing St.
Sevies, her home, she came to know deep anguish.
And so she walks on...
cursing the folly that could not make use even of the
sword she believed in, as her impulses take her.
As if laying herself bare to the dangers that lie
ahead...

Shutting oneself away in a special place to cleanse
body and mind defiled by curses or spirits, through
bathing, fasting and the like.
A very long seclusion has come to mean years spent
cleansing body and mind, or the person who does so.

Navilos Lucifuge (68, female)
Head of the Hall.
She was seized and charged with darkness for
summoning the Crawlers.
She is said to have refused Paladine's proposal with
silence, and so refused to save the school from its
crisis.
What was in the mind of the beloved pupil of the
Head of Silence, that she held her tongue...?
Everyone is searching for the words left unspoken.

Fanna Hyverios (15, female)
Deeply sensitive and perfectly natural.
A princess of the old and mighty Hyverios, one of the
four royal houses of the Eastern Campaign, with a
lovely, open smile.
She fears nothing, never flinches, never retreats.
Believing that one should always act when the time
comes, she stands out in St. Sevies, the peak of the
Four, where contemplation is prized.
Her gallant, brisk stride shows a heart no frame can
hold, and her endless smile gives courage to all who
see it.

Ney Prawdis (15)
A cool-eyed master archer, a wielder of the flowing
sword, and a sorcerer who drives sharp words.
The brilliance that made Denehere Ruverdracloa say
"Paladine has a Minister of Smiles,"
Ney has always stood out, even in the Hall of Wisdom,
where great people gather like shining stars.
And then, Ney suddenly faces forward.
Amid new meetings, straight ahead.

Gerait Robery (27, male)
The core of Innocentia's golden age, built by
Denehere.
He first won fame in the Aquoria Holy Knights, but left
the order for his own reasons.
Since then, with no real goal, he has studied widely
without aim.
Great gifts, with no one to test them against: an
emptiness...
It is no exaggeration to say Robery's emptiness is also
a worry to his old teacher Denehere.

Cheryl Genowarth (25, female)
A sage apprentice who serves Navilos Lucifuge, the
Jet Black.
A woman whose sincere manner, never cutting
corners in anything, wins the goodwill of all who see
her.
Though she holds to contemplation, her habit of
voicing her worries and doubts shows she is not yet
quite a sage.
As successor of St. Sevies, great hopes rest on her
future.

Schneidra Balesti (33, male)
A sage of matchless logic.
One of the foremost sorcerers of the age, who
believes in the magic called reason.
Blind, his senses are honed, and the words he thrusts
out pierce his opponents' weak points.
As minister of his homeland Odicles, he had close ties
with the school's sages, which helped bring him to
the Sages' Round Table.
Some dislike his biting tongue and his ruthless skill.
But it is just as certain that great hopes rest on him as
the spearhead against the Chaos that has come to
Elmenas.

The highest decision-making body of Elmenas, made
up of at least five sages.
Having lost its true seat, the Royal Cente, it now
gathers around a new table in the Watchtower.
Whether because of that, or by not a few wills, it
seems to adopt policies that lean toward Paladine.

Callot Winfy (13, female)
Her big, ever-darting eyes are full of curiosity
anytime, anywhere.
To her, everything she sees is like a kitten lazing by
the fire.
She can't help poking at everything.
One moment she's turning the toy box upside down,
the next she's racing about with dazzling agility, and
sometimes Callot is down, close to tears.
She is innocence and cheer itself.
With the blood of the Bow God of Dahatma, a new
road to becoming a sage opens before the girl.

Baubes Foretod (95, male)
A fire sorcerer who drives crimson flame.
In his youth, a sinner who burned many nations with
cruel fire.
But that was over fifty years ago; now he is a pillar of
Elmenas, fulfilling his duty as a sage.
Few know his grim past, but Baubes himself spares
no effort in raising the next generation, in atonement.

Papesh Fake (125, male)
Head of Keys.
He has fine insight and a view all his own.
So he confuses meetings with odd remarks, or
suddenly cuts to the heart of things, a little-folk man
who lives out his character to the full.
If you know what it is to be a little different...
studying under him, a hunter and a swordsman, may
be a short road to mastery.

Quest Shnonsaw (11, female)
A girl wrapped in a dreamy air.
Speak to her, and she only answers with a shy smile.
She was found eleven years ago, nameless,
abandoned and freezing.
Without any agreement between them, old sages who
pitied her looked after her a little, morning and
night...
perhaps that is why, as the years went by, her talent
began to bud.
She speaks little, perhaps following the old men who
taught her, but her moist upturned eyes are full of
curiosity.
As if seeing through people's hearts, she turns on
them a gaze of deep trust.

Syalon Flayspid (13, female)
A girl who lost her beloved family to war at just eight
years old, carved her own blood into the silver
snowfield and swore revenge.
Her unwavering words and deeds may seem upheld
by a noble, pure will that takes no thought for herself.
That is surely the anguish of a young girl, burning
herself with hatred, yet gasping in a sorrow deep
enough to crush her heart.
Syalon, who embraced darkness in her heart because
she was as innocent as snow.
Who will set her free of that curse: a teacher, a friend,
or only the fulfilment of a vow stained in blood...

Batra Fedrinsk (77, female)
Head of Scales.
A gallant old woman who drives the magic of water
and earth.
She openly argued against the Sages' Round Table,
which gives weight to Paladine's word.
But she was not heard, and was bound in chains of
everlasting dark.
She is the elder sister of Navilos, who guides St.
Sevies in the Hall of Contemplation, and one of the
foremost women sages.

Iris Winkvalley (32, female)
The sorcerer who tilled the soil for the Shield of
Purity's golden age.
Most of her arts belong to the earth, and she became
the linchpin supporting the front line.
In the Shield of Purity, caught up in long battles,
people still talk of how much her careful
thoughtfulness held them up.
She left twelve years ago and works on to settle the
conflicts centred on Beldracle.
Her younger sister, Yuri Winkvalley, is also in
Innocentia.

The sages in black robes who once threw Elmenas
into the depths of despair.
They have a past of trampling all the trust placed in
them and leading the school to the brink of ruin.
They were believed to be still cursed, bound in
eternal darkness...
but riding the power of Chaos, they seek to lead the
school to ruin once more.

The thirteenth Chalice, lost in the battle nine years
ago.
The Innocent Chalice, added to the twelve Chalices
that lead to hope.
A forbidden secret art that leaves all good and evil to
the one who wishes.

Ruin: the end Elmenas itself desires.
What it wished for with the thirteen Chalices was for
the school to bring down its own curtain.
Navilos, the Cursed in Black, the children, and
Elmenas.
Feelings folded layer upon layer gather toward the
final battle.
